cases.name: row-outcome-flipped
cases.what: row 4's outcome edited on disk; hashes left as they were

cases.name: row-prev-hash-edited
cases.what: row 6's prev_hash replaced; its own row_hash left as it was

cases.name: row-rehashed-after-edit
cases.what: row 4 edited and its own hash recomputed from its prev_hash; row 5's prev_hash no longer matches

cases.name: rows-rehashed-forward-not-resigned
cases.what: row 4 edited and every hash recomputed forward; the record still signs the old terminal hash

cases.name: rows-rehashed-forward-resigned
cases.what: row 4 edited, hashes recomputed forward, counts re-derived, record re-signed by the producer (replay would catch it; nothing else can)

cases.name: row-deleted-resigned
cases.what: row 7 deleted, the rest renumbered, counts re-derived, record re-signed: the completeness limit

cases.name: row-deleted-resigned-keyed
cases.what: row 7 deleted, the rest renumbered, counts re-derived, record re-signed: the completeness limit

cases.name: counts-wrong
cases.what: counts.decisions off by one in the record; signature now stale

cases.name: counts-wrong-resigned
cases.what: counts.decisions off by one and the record re-signed

cases.name: profile-lies-production
cases.what: a benchmark ledger declared production, benchmark block removed, re-signed

cases.name: profile-claims-benchmark
cases.what: an unlabelled ledger declared benchmark, re-signed

cases.name: payload-hash-wrong
cases.what: payload_hash replaced; signature untouched

cases.name: signature-wrong
cases.what: last bytes of the signature altered

cases.name: unknown-key-id
cases.what: signing_key_id names a key the registry does not have; signed by the producer's key, re-signed

cases.name: signed-by-retired-key
cases.what: signed by the retired key under its own id

cases.name: signed-by-revoked-key
cases.what: signed by the revoked key; the registry does not list this payload_hash

cases.name: retained-file-missing
cases.what: inputs.jsonl absent from this copy

cases.name: retained-file-differs
cases.what: policy.json has one byte appended; its digest no longer matches

cases.name: format-version-unknown
cases.what: format_version 99, re-signed

cases.name: row-version-unknown
cases.what: every row declares v 99

cases.name: rows-mixed-versions
cases.what: row 3 declares v 2 in a v 1 ledger

cases.name: row-undeclared-key
cases.what: row 1 carries a key the row version does not declare

cases.name: extra-file-unnamed
cases.what: a file beside the ledger that the record does not name

cases.name: stream-prior-wrong
cases.what: stream.prev_record_hash does not match the prior supplied

cases.name: receipt-row-deleted
cases.what: row 20 deleted from the tail, counts re-derived, record re-signed; the receipt for decision 20 is still supplied

cases.name: receipt-foreign
cases.what: a receipt issued for the next record in the stream (hour 2, its decision 1, which is decision 21 of the stream) supplied against hour 1

cases.name: witness-altered
cases.what: the witness statement supplied names a different payload_hash (case options point at an altered copy)

cases.name: witness-self-signed
cases.what: a witness statement signed with the producer's own key, under a witness registry that enrols that key as 'independent-auditor-2026-10'

cases.name: record-not-json
cases.what: record.json is not JSON: the directory cannot be read

cases.name: ledger-missing
cases.what: the ledger file the record names is absent

cases.name: attestation-forged
cases.what: attestation for seq 2 edited; record re-signed by the producer

cases.name: attestation-missing
cases.what: attestations for seq 4 and 5 removed; record re-signed
